change: Generic12 BUFF timed_status quick-slot casts are now self-centered and no longer require a selected monster when the skill is self-origin.
rules: Quick-slot Generic12 BUFF timed_status skills use the caster as the cast origin and skip monster-distance/auto-approach checks.
Self-centered AoE status skills still affect valid nearby combat targets; they are not converted into a single-target self buff.
Official Skill Self + SplashArea is used when a runtime profile has no hand-written targeting block.
Enemy-target timed_status skills still require a valid current monster.
The 12 Generic12 effect assets and 617 skill mappings are unchanged.
